race.comment: PRINCE IS GAME (10) has won his only race here over the trip, and a wet track would be in his favour. He fought on gamely for sixth at Taree 11 days ago over 1600m, and the return to 2000m will suit him, especially with 4.5kg less to carry. Stick with him on top. CLASSIC DEEL (6) has been out of form over the winter and has been given a freshen-up since her last run nearly 7 weeks ago. Aaron Bullock in the saddle is a strong lead for the stable, and she is worth one more chance. CAN'T RECALL ONE (4) ran on powerfully late to finish third over 1600m at Kembla Grange nearly 2 weeks ago, and that form will hold up nicely at this level. He is strong enough now to cope with a middle distance, and he should go close to taking this out. STROBING (7) is a durable veteran who won his last start. He has top 4 claims in this.
